name: Job Ops
description: Job Ops applies DevOps principles to job hunting. It searches job boards, scores matches with an LLM, builds a tailored resume per role and tracks application status from Gmail replies.

notes.text: Job Ops has no sign-in by default. Set BASIC_AUTH_USER and BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD in /opt/job-ops/.env and run 'systemctl restart job-ops' before exposing it beyond a trusted network.
Finish setup in the onboarding wizard at http://<IP>:3005. LLM, Reactive Resume and Gmail credentials are entered there or in /opt/job-ops/.env.
The database, generated PDFs and Codex login are in /var/lib/job-ops. Back that directory up together with /opt/job-ops/.env.
